artifacts.summary: Six-phase plan (4 waves, 7h): land relational TruthCorr in Truth.lean and derive timeShift_preserves_truth, truthAt_map, and truthAt_of_truthIso from it with statements unchanged; re-pin the 10 drifted paper-definition anchors; docstring hygiene (by-label citations, convex wording, H_F quotes); closure gates and induction ledger.

memory_candidates.content: When a generic transport lemma must range over a dependently-typed structure (e.g. Lean WorldHistory with `states` indexed by a domain proof), package the transport as a Prop-valued RELATION with existence clauses in both directions (Rel, total_fwd, total_bwd) rather than an Equiv on the structure. The Equiv route forces a dependent structure equality and degenerates into HEq; the relational route needs only pointwise agreement plus a `states_eq_of_time_eq`-style congruence and matches how the source paper proves the box case (existence forward + existence backward + IH at a related pair). Concretely in BimodalLogic: `TruthCorr` (dur : order-iso, Rel, atom, total_fwd, total_bwd) derives timeShift_preserves_truth, IntTransfer.truthAt_map, and truthAt_of_truthIso unchanged, while `TruthIso.hist : HF ≃ HF'` could reach only total histories. Applies whenever a bijective packaging is stronger than what the mathematical proof consumes.
